Sales lead generation

Lead forms on Facebook and Instagram

1,444
leads at ₹24.69 each

I learned the most from this account. Across all its campaigns I spent about ₹1.13 lakh and reached 3.97 lakh people. Some ad sets got leads at just ₹11.86 and ₹12.81, while others crossed ₹47. My daily job was to find which was which and move the budget to the better ones.

  • ₹35,657 spent on the main campaign
  • 1.87 lakh impressions

Construction business

Local leads and callback requests

64
leads from one ad set

For a construction client I ran lead forms and a callback campaign where people could ask for a call. The best ad set got 563 link clicks at ₹5.84 each. That is a good price for a service people think about for a long time before buying.

  • 89,027 impressions
  • 57,096 people reached
  • ₹36.96 CPM
